name: Get client config
description: Call this when you need the signed-in account's display and locale context — organization name, timezone, time format — or to check whether a given app (e.g. SMS campaigns) is already activated before driving a campaign flow, since the response reports activation state per app. Use this as the read-only check that pairs with the separate app-activation action (account.enable_sms_campaigns_app) when activation turns out to be needed; prefer the organization details action (organization.get_details) when you need fuller organization metadata rather than app activation and formatting flags.
preconditions: An authenticated Brevo web session (the endpoint resolves the account from the session, not from a path parameter).
Any app named in app_to_activate must correspond to an app Brevo recognises for the account.

app_to_activate.description: Name of the app whose activation state should be reflected in the app_activated map of the response, as observed on the campaigns listing route. Observed value: "sms-campaigns".

organization_name.description: Display name of the organization owning the session, e.g. "TestBoxTest".

timezone.description: IANA timezone the account's dates and schedules are rendered in, e.g. "America/Sao_Paulo".

timeformat.description: Clock format the UI uses for times, e.g. "24".

app_activated.description: Map of app name to whether that app is activated for the account. Keys observed reflect the app_to_activate query value.

marketing_sms_link_shortening_enabled.description: Whether link shortening is enabled for marketing SMS on this account.
